cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening Auction），期间可继续提交订单/报价，以撮合成交量最大的价格定开盘价（Netting流程）
cells.en: Opening Auction; additional Orders and Quotes may still be entered during the auction, with the opening price determined via a netting process maximizing matched volume

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing Auction），部分品种另设盘中收盘集合竞价（intra-day Closing Auction）
cells.en: Closing Auction; some instruments also have intra-day Closing Auctions

cells.zh: 市价申报、限价申报、止损申报（Market/Limit/Stop Orders），另支持多种复合工具（跨期价差组合等）
cells.en: Market Orders, Limit Orders, Stop Orders; complex instruments (e.g. calendar spread strategies) are also supported

cells.zh: 动态/静态价格区间（Dynamic/Static Price Range），预期成交价超出区间即触发波动性中断，而非直接禁止申报的固定涨跌停
cells.en: Dynamic/static price ranges; when the next expected execution price falls outside the range, a Volatility Interruption is triggered rather than the order being flatly rejected as with a fixed daily limit

cells.zh: 区间宽度与参考价由管理董事会（Management Board）按每个衍生品逐一确定，未公开统一的百分比表（与JPX值幅制限、美股LULD的Tier分级不同，本所未见公开的统一档位表）
cells.en: The size of each price range and its reference prices are set by the Management Board per Derivative; no single published percentage table was found (unlike JPX's tiered yen bands or the U.S. LULD Tier system)

cells.zh: 无独立于波动性中断之外的全市场级熔断；波动性中断（见volatility_interruption）触发后管理董事会可扩大到同一衍生品的全部合约暂停交易，但本次未找到覆盖全市场所有产品的熔断安排
cells.en: No market-wide circuit breaker separate from the Volatility Interruption mechanism; upon a Volatility Interruption the Management Board may extend the trading halt to all Instruments of the same Derivative, but no exchange-wide halt covering all products was found in the content fetched this session

cells.zh: 波动性中断（Volatility Interruption）：预期成交价超出动态或静态价格区间即触发，中断后以集合竞价方式恢复交易（紧接的收盘集合竞价除外）
cells.en: Volatility Interruption: triggered when the next expected execution price falls outside the dynamic or static price range; trading resumes via an auction (unless immediately followed by a Closing Auction)

cells.zh: 受监管做市商制度（Regulated Market Maker）：需申请获得资格，须在至少一个衍生品品种上按月平均覆盖每日交易时段50%的时间持续提供双边报价，具体点差/报价量要求由管理董事会另行规定
cells.en: Regulated Market Maker system: admission required; must continuously enter binding two-way quotes in at least one Derivative covering 50% of daily Trading Hours on a monthly average, with specific spread/volume requirements set separately by the Management Board

cells.zh: 欧洲期货结算公司
cells.en: Eurex Clearing AG

cells.zh: 视产品而定：实物交割为默认方式（如部分利率/债券期货），管理董事会可决定排除实物交割改为现金结算
cells.en: Depends on the product: physical delivery is the default for some products (e.g. certain interest-rate/bond futures); the Management Board may rule out physical delivery in favor of cash settlement

cells.zh: 分「获准公司」（Admitted Companies）与「交易员」（Exchange Traders）两层：公司须获准参与交易所交易，个人交易员须通过资格考试（Exchange Trader Examination）后方可代表获准公司下单
cells.en: Two-tier structure: "Admitted Companies" must be admitted to exchange trading, and individual "Exchange Traders" must pass an Exchange Trader Examination before placing orders on behalf of an Admitted Company

cells.zh: 按三类收费：交易参与准入费、交易参与年费（由管理董事会确定）、交易员资格考试费；另有成交撤销/更正申请费每笔500欧元
cells.en: Three fee categories: admission fee, annual participation fee (set by the Management Board), and Exchange Trader examination fee; a separate EUR 500 fee applies per cancellation/correction application

cells.zh: 值幅制限：按前收盘价所在区间，分37档规定绝对值幅（非百分比），如100円以下±30円……5000万円以上±1000万円
cells.en: Price limits on bids and offers: 37 tiers of absolute yen amounts (not percentages) keyed to the base price band, e.g. under 100 yen → ±30 yen ... 50,000,000 yen or more → ±10,000,000 yen

cells.zh: 见 type 字段的37档完整表；档位随基准价升高而放大，非固定比例
cells.en: See the 37-tier table in the type field; the band widens as the base price rises, not a fixed percentage

cells.zh: 无独立的全市场熔断机制（如美股MWCB）；波动控制主要通过「特別気配」（特别行情揭示）机制实现——申报价格超出值幅制限的基准价时，不直接成交，而是显示特别气配指示性价格，上午盘超出即不成交，下午盘则按值幅制限价位处理
cells.en: No separate market-wide circuit breaker (unlike the U.S. MWCB); volatility control operates primarily through the "special quote" mechanism — when an order price would exceed the price-limit band around the base price, no trade is executed at that price; instead a special indicative quote is displayed. In the morning session no transaction is effected; in the afternoon session trading is capped at the price limit

cells.zh: 同 circuit_breaker 所述的「特別気配」机制——本质是值幅制限的执行方式，而非独立的波动性中断层，与港交所VCM那种独立于涨跌停之外的冷静期机制不是同一类设计
cells.en: Same "special quote" mechanism described under circuit_breaker — it is the enforcement mechanism of the price-limit system itself, not a separate volatility-interruption layer distinct from price limits (unlike HKEX's VCM, which operates independently of any daily price limit since HKEX has none)

cells.zh: 现货股票交收前不得卖出（不可当日回转），与结算层面T+2（见 clearing.settlement_cycle）相配套
cells.en: Securities purchased may not be sold before settlement (no same-day round-trip); pairs with the T+2 settlement cycle (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 卖空须向交易所披露（标记申报），且受价格限制约束（Rule 16「卖空价格限制基准价」），类似报升规则，具体触发比例本次未能在抓取内容中确认
cells.en: Short sales must be flagged/disclosed to the Exchange and are subject to a price restriction (Rule 16, "Base Prices with Short Selling Price Restriction"), functionally similar to an uptick rule; the specific trigger percentage was not confirmed in the content fetched this session

cells.zh: 披露为本，交易所设初次上市审查，重大事项另须向金融厅报告
cells.en: Disclosure-based; the Exchange conducts initial listing examinations, with major matters also reportable to the FSA

cells.en: T+2 (effective July 16, 2019; previously longer)

cells.en: Not applicable (cash market, book-entry settlement via JASDEC, no physical delivery)

cells.zh: 交易参与者（Trading Participant）制度，须通过资格审查取得交易资格
cells.en: Trading Participant system; qualification obtained through an examination process

cells.zh: 公司制（2001年7月由会员制改制为公众公司）
cells.en: Demutualized (became a public company in July 2001)

cells.zh: 2001年7月LSE本身曾作为独立公众公司在自己市场挂牌；2007年10月与Borsa Italiana合并组成LSEG集团后，当前的挂牌主体是集团控股公司London Stock Exchange Group plc（LSEG plc），而非“伦敦证券交易所”这一运营法人实体本身
cells.en: London Stock Exchange itself listed on its own market in July 2001; following the October 2007 merger with Borsa Italiana that formed LSEG, the entity currently listed is the group holding company, London Stock Exchange Group plc, rather than the operating exchange entity itself

cells.zh: 英镑（GBP）为主；国际预托凭证及部分交易所买卖产品（ETP）等品类另有多币种报价（如以Euroclear Bank结算的ETP）
cells.en: Primarily GBP; certain segments such as international depositary receipts and some ETPs quote in other currencies (e.g. ETPs settled via Euroclear Bank)

cells.zh: 金融行为监管局（Financial Conduct Authority, FCA）——作为英国上市监管机关（UK Listing Authority职能），维护官方名册（Official List）并制定UK Listing Rules（UKLR）
cells.en: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) — acts as the UK Listing Authority, maintains the Official List and makes the UK Listing Rules (UKLR)

cells.zh: 伦敦证券交易所本身作为“认可投资交易所”（Recognised Investment Exchange, RIE），对市场准入交易与市场运作承担一线监管职责，须遵守FCA就RIE制定的监管手册（sourcebook）要求
cells.en: London Stock Exchange itself, as a Recognised Investment Exchange (RIE) under UK law, carries front-line responsibility for admission to trading and market operation, subject to the FCA's sourcebook for Recognised Investment Exchanges

cells.zh: 《2000年金融服务与市场法》（Financial Services and Markets Act 2000, FSMA）
cells.en: Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (FSMA)

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening Auction Call）
cells.en: Opening Auction Call

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价，随后进入短暂的收盘价交叉时段（CPX），允许以收盘价继续撮合剩余订单
cells.en: Closing Auction, followed by a brief Closing Price Crossing Session (CPX) allowing continued execution at the closing auction price

cells.zh: 限价订单（Limit Order）、市价订单（Market Order，无价格优先于所有限价订单）、止损订单/止损限价订单（Stop/Stop Limit Order）、冰山订单（Iceberg Order，仅展示部分数量）、隐藏限价订单（Hidden Limit Order）、中间价挂钩订单（Mid-Price Pegged Order，仅在盘中以买卖中间价成交）
cells.en: Limit Order, Market Order (unpriced, has price priority over all priced orders), Stop / Stop Limit Order, Iceberg Order (displays only a portion of total volume), Hidden Limit Order (non-displayed), Mid-Price Pegged Order (executes only at the mid BID/OFFER price during regular trading)

cells.zh: 非固定百分比涨跌停板，而是逐证券（security-by-security）的价格监控机制——静态价格监控（相对开盘集合竞价价格的偏离阈值）与动态价格监控（相对最近成交价的偏离阈值）触发后，转入波动性拍卖重新形成价格，而非直接停牌
cells.en: Not a fixed percentage limit-up/limit-down band; instead a security-by-security price monitoring mechanism — static price monitoring (deviation from the opening auction price) and dynamic price monitoring (deviation from the last traded price) trigger a volatility auction to re-form the price, rather than a straight halt

cells.zh: 以富时100成分股为例：静态价格监控阈值8%（相对上一次集合竞价成交价），动态价格监控阈值3%（相对最近成交价，触发5分钟波动性拍卖，含最多一次2分钟市价订单延期）；次一流动性梯队（如LSE行业分类FS10）静态阈值10%、动态阈值5%；富时100盘中/收盘/EDSP拍卖的动态阈值比常规交易更紧（FE10为1%，FS10为3%）
cells.en: For FTSE 100 constituents: static price monitoring threshold 8% (vs. last auction uncrossing price), dynamic threshold 3% (vs. last traded price, triggering a 5-minute volatility auction with up to one 2-minute Market Order extension); the next liquidity tier (e.g. LSE sector FS10) uses 10% static / 5% dynamic; FTSE 100 intraday/closing/EDSP auctions use tighter dynamic thresholds than regular trading (1% for FE10, 3% for FS10)

cells.zh: 个股级价格监控机制（无美股式全市场熔断）：不同于美国基于标普500指数跌幅触发的全市场熔断（暂停全部股票交易15分钟），伦敦证券交易所采用逐证券的价格监控功能
cells.en: Stock-level price monitoring mechanism (no US-style market-wide circuit breaker): unlike US market-wide circuit breakers that pause all stocks for 15 minutes based on S&P 500 declines, LSE employs a security-by-security price monitoring mechanism

cells.zh: 静态价格监控（Static Price Monitoring）与动态价格监控（Dynamic Price Monitoring）触发后转入波动性拍卖（volatility auction），价格重新形成后恢复常规交易；每次拍卖及延期后另设最长30秒随机时间
cells.en: Static and Dynamic Price Monitoring trigger a volatility auction; once the price re-forms, regular trading resumes; each auction/extension is followed by a random period of up to 30 seconds

cells.zh: 《2025年卖空规则》（Short Selling Regulations 2025, SSR 2025）——脱欧后英国自订的独立卖空监管框架，2026年7月13日起正式取代此前“承接”的欧盟《卖空条例》（Regulation (EU) No 236/2012）。持有可报告股票净空头仓位达0.2%阈值须向FCA报告，FCA公布匿名化的汇总净空头仓位（ANSP）；FCA保留在特殊情形下实施限制/禁止卖空的紧急权力
cells.en: Short Selling Regulations 2025 (SSR 2025) — the UK's own post-Brexit short-selling framework, which from 13 July 2026 replaced the previously-assimilated EU Short Selling Regulation (Regulation (EU) No 236/2012). Net short positions in reportable shares must be notified to the FCA once the 0.2% threshold is reached; the FCA publishes anonymised Aggregate Net Short Positions (ANSP); the FCA retains emergency powers to restrict or ban short selling in exceptional circumstances

cells.zh: 分订单驱动与报价驱动两套做市商制度：SETS/IOB/证券化衍生品/固定收益订单簿等订单驱动品种，注册做市商以可执行报价（Executable Quotes）参与；SETSqx/SEAQ/欧洲报价服务等报价驱动品种，注册做市商以非电子可执行的确定报价（Firm Quotes）参与，且仅具备中央对手方清算资格的会员机构方可注册为报价驱动品种做市商
cells.en: Two parallel market maker regimes: order-driven instruments (SETS, IOB, securitised derivatives, fixed income order book) use registered market makers quoting Executable Quotes; quote-driven instruments (SETSqx, SEAQ, European Quoting Service) use registered market makers providing non-electronically-executable Firm Quotes, and only member firms with central counterparty clearing capability may register as quote-driven market makers

cells.zh: 披露为本，2024年7月UKLR改革后以单一“股票证券（商业公司）”类别取代此前Premium/Standard两级架构；申请人须在多类触发事件（如须发布招股说明书、反向收购通函等）委任一名保荐人（Sponsor）向FCA确认其符合UKLR相关要求
cells.en: Disclosure-based; following the July 2024 UKLR reform, a single 'equity shares (commercial companies)' category replaced the previous two-tier Premium/Standard structure. Issuers must appoint a Sponsor on multiple trigger events (e.g. when a prospectus or reverse-takeover circular is required) to confirm compliance with the relevant UKLR requirements to the FCA

cells.zh: FCA认定存在阻碍证券正常常规交易的特殊情形即可取消上市，典型触发情形包括：证券已不再符合本规则要求获准交易；发行人不再满足持续义务（如公众持股比例跌破10%，FCA可给予合理期限恢复但受市场平稳运行/投资者保护需要限制）；暂停上市已满6个月；发行人完成反向收购或“初始交易”（initial transaction）
cells.en: The FCA may cancel a listing where it is satisfied that special circumstances preclude normal regular dealings, including: securities no longer admitted to trading as required; the issuer no longer satisfying continuing obligations (e.g. shares in public hands falling below 10%, subject to a reasonable restoration period unless precluded by market-order/investor-protection needs); the listing having been suspended for more than 6 months; or the issuer completing a reverse takeover or 'initial transaction'

cells.zh: T+2（现行）；英国计划于2027年10月11日整体切换为T+1，本次核实时点（2026-08-14）尚未生效
cells.en: T+2 (current); the UK is planning a market-wide move to T+1 on 11 October 2027, which had not yet taken effect as of this session's verification date (2026-08-14)

cells.zh: LCH Ltd——LSEG集团清算业务（LCH集团）旗下英国主体，作为中央对手方为包括股票在内的多资产类别提供清算服务
cells.en: LCH Ltd — the UK entity of LSEG's clearing business (LCH Group), acting as central counterparty across multiple asset classes including equities

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，无实物/现金交割概念）
cells.en: Not applicable (cash market; no physical/cash delivery concept)

cells.zh: 会员机构（member firm）制：须在英国或适格境外法域获得授权监管（或经交易所认定在资本充足性、诚信与专业能力方面已受充分监管），须持有有效LEI码，须具备充足的交易执行、记录、报告与结算能力及至少一名合规官
cells.en: Member firm structure: must be authorised under UK or appropriate overseas legislation (or otherwise deemed sufficiently regulated for capital adequacy and fitness/probity), must hold a valid LEI, and must maintain adequate trade execution, recording, reporting and settlement capabilities plus at least one compliance officer

cells.zh: 会员交易费：按月度累计成交金额分档收取基点费率（Standard value traded scheme：首£35亿0.45个基点，其后£50亿0.35个基点，超出部分0.25个基点，月度封顶£15,000），另设流动性提供计划（Liquidity Provider Scheme）对被动成交给予返佣（负费率）；发行人上市费：股票类新上市按市值分级累进收取（如£0-5百万区间为最低费£17,600，此后每百万递增£2,305……最高累计£698,000+20%增值税），另按上市证券市值每年收取年费（如£175百万市值对应年费£11,750，按每百万£60递增，上限£265,000）
cells.en: Member trading fees: tiered basis-point rates by monthly cumulative value traded (Standard value traded scheme: 0.45bp on the first £3.5bn, 0.35bp on the next £5bn, 0.25bp thereafter, capped at £15,000/month), plus a Liquidity Provider Scheme offering rebates (negative fees) for passive execution; issuer fees: admission fees for new equity listings are tiered by market capitalisation (e.g. minimum fee £17,600 for the £0-5m band, then £2,305 per additional £1m... cumulative maximum £698,000 plus 20% VAT), plus an annual fee based on listed market capitalisation (e.g. £11,750 minimum for a £175m market cap, £60 per £1m thereafter, capped at £265,000)

cells.zh: 印花税（Stamp Duty）：纸质转让文书形式、金额超£1,000的证券交易，税率0.5%（就近取整至£5）；印花税储备税（Stamp Duty Reserve Tax, SDRT）：电子（无纸化）交易，税率0.5%（就近取整至1便士），经CREST系统自动代收并划付予英国税务海关总署（HMRC）
cells.en: Stamp Duty: 0.5% (rounded to the nearest £5) on paper-form share transfers over £1,000; Stamp Duty Reserve Tax (SDRT): 0.5% (rounded to the nearest 1p) on electronic (paperless) transactions, automatically collected via CREST and remitted to HMRC

cells.zh: 公司制（2006年由会员制改制）
cells.en: Demutualized (2006)

cells.zh: 并非NYSE实体本身上市，而是其母公司洲际交易所（ICE）在纽交所上市（股票代码 ICE）
cells.en: Not NYSE itself; parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) is listed on NYSE

cells.zh: 美元 (USD)
cells.en: USD

cells.zh: 美国证券交易委员会
cells.en: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)

cells.zh: NYSE Regulation（交易所自身的一线监管部门）；金融业监管局（FINRA）按监管服务协议代为执行部分跨市场执法工作
cells.en: NYSE Regulation; FINRA (via Regulatory Services Agreements)

cells.zh: 《1934年证券交易法》
cells.en: Securities Exchange Act of 1934

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（9:30am），由指定做市商（DMM）主持
cells.en: Core Open Auction, facilitated by the Designated Market Maker (DMM)

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（4:00pm），3:50-4:00pm为收盘失衡期
cells.en: Closing Auction, preceded by a Closing Imbalance Period

cells.zh: 限价订单、市价订单（且有多种细分类型，如Five Best Orders Immediate or Cancel等）；具体订单类型矩阵未逐条核实
cells.en: Limit Order, Market Order (multiple sub-types)

cells.zh: 涨跌限价机制（LULD），非固定百分比/绝对值幅，而是以过去5分钟均价为基准动态计算的价格带
cells.en: Limit Up-Limit Down (LULD)

cells.zh: 按Tier 1（标普500/罗素1000/部分ETP）与Tier 2（其余NMS证券）分级设定价格带百分比，具体档位数值本次未在抓取页面中找到
cells.en: Price bands are set by Tier 1 (S&P 500 / Russell 1000 / select ETPs) vs. Tier 2 (other NMS securities); the specific percentage figures were not found in the pages fetched this session

cells.zh: 全市场熔断（Market-Wide Circuit Breaker, MWCB），基于标普500指数单日跌幅触发三级阈值：7%（一级）、13%（二级）、20%（三级）
cells.en: Market-Wide Circuit Breaker (MWCB)

cells.zh: 涨跌限价机制（LULD）本身即承担个股级波动性中断功能：价格持续处于价格带边缘会触发交易暂停
cells.en: LULD serves as the stock-level volatility interruption mechanism

cells.zh: T+0（可当日回转），与结算层面的T+1（见 clearing.settlement_cycle）是两回事
cells.en: T+0 (same-day round-trip trading allowed); distinct from the T+1 settlement cycle (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 受Regulation SHO监管，含卖空限制熔断机制（SSR）；具体触发阈值（如报升规则的百分比）本次未能在NYSE/SEC/FINRA官网核实到直接原文
cells.en: Regulated under Regulation SHO, incl. Short Sale Restriction (SSR) circuit breaker

cells.zh: 指定做市商制度（DMM）：每支股票指定一名DMM，负责在开盘、收盘及严重失衡/不稳定期间维持价格发现
cells.en: Designated Market Maker (DMM)

cells.zh: 披露为本（非注册制/核准制二分），设有量化+定性双重上市标准，由Issuer Regulation团队审核
cells.en: Disclosure-based (not a simple registration/approval binary); combines quantitative and qualitative listing standards, reviewed by the Issuer Regulation team

cells.zh: 未达持续上市定量/定性标准触发退市；具体阈值（如最低股价规则）本次未逐条核实
cells.en: Non-compliance with quantitative or qualitative continued listing standards
T+1 (effective May 28, 2024; previously T+2)

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，无实物/现金交割概念）
cells.en: Not applicable (cash market; no physical/cash delivery concept)

cells.zh: 会员组织（member organization）体系，须通过NYSE Regulation合规审查
cells.en: Member organization structure; subject to NYSE Regulation compliance review

cells.zh: 做市商-吃单者模式（maker-taker）：为市场提供流动性的报单可获返佣（如每股0.0012美元量级），吃走流动性的一方付费；费率按会员机构的报价/成交量分层，逐月计算
cells.en: Maker-taker pricing model
